baseline_models.focus_anchor: هَاجَرُوا at word 2 joined to فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ at words 3-5.
baseline_models.mechanism: Migration combines severance from an attachment or dwelling with entry onto an extended, traversable way. The construction makes departure a continuing God-oriented course rather than a completed change of address.

activation_trace.role: Severance and separation supply the rupture from a former attachment that initiates the movement.
Departure from one dwelling to another gives the rupture concrete spatial direction.
An extended way that is actually traversed turns the departure into an ongoing route.
The worshiped one supplies the route's stated orientation and prevents severance from becoming aimless exile.

changed_reading.after: They accepted a real severance and entered a God-oriented course whose significance continues beyond the act of leaving.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ثُمَّ قُتِلُوا أَوْ مَاتُوا at words 6-9 under the single emphatic promise beginning at word 10.
baseline_models.mechanism: Externally inflicted killing and the ordinary loss of life are coordinated by أَوْ and receive exactly the same provision promise. The verse therefore refuses to make a dramatic manner of death the gatekeeper of the migrant's outcome.

activation_trace.role: The taking of life supplies the violent and externally caused endpoint.
Loss of force and life supplies the nonviolent endpoint placed beside killing.
One allotted gift covers both endpoints and makes their difference irrelevant to the promise.

changed_reading.before: The slain migrant receives the distinctive reward, while one who merely dies is a secondary case.
changed_reading.after: Killing and ordinary death are deliberately equalized as two routes into one outcome; prior fidelity, not the spectacle of death, carries the promise.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root ر ز ق occurs as promised action, cognate object, and provider-title at words 10, 12, and 18, qualified by حَسَنًا and خَيْرُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated root saturates the close of the verse with giver, gift, and giving. Its branches hold together an assigned share and usable nourishment, while حسن and خير make quality and source, not bare quantity, decisive.

activation_trace.role: An apportioned gift gives the promise the precision of an assigned share rather than an abstract reward.
Nourishing sustenance makes the share life-supporting rather than merely honorific.
Goodness opposed to ugliness qualifies the character of what is apportioned.
Beneficial good makes the provider's superiority practical for the recipients.
Excellence and selection sharpen 'best' into superiority of both giver and chosen share.

changed_reading.before: God grants them a generic heavenly reward.
changed_reading.after: God assigns a specifically sustaining share whose goodness lies in its use, its selection, and the unmatched reliability of its giver.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 22:11, immediate good stabilizes an edge-conditioned worshiper until trial turns him back into loss. At 22:58, good provision comes only after severance and either form of death. The recurrence relocates good from a condition demanded before fidelity to a promise received after fidelity has survived total worldly loss.

activation_trace.role: Beneficial good names the favorable event on which the earlier worshiper's stability depends.
Assaying metal or persons makes adversity a test that exposes the conditional posture.
Turning a thing off its face supplies the reversal caused by trial.
General diminution supplies the apparent loss against which the later promise is heard.
The focus allotment arrives after fidelity rather than functioning as its advance condition.

structural_cues: 22:11 balances 'if good reaches him' against 'if trial reaches him' and locates worship عَلَىٰ حَرْفٍ at word 7; the packet supplies no matching edge branch ID, so the edge remains a structural cue only.
22:58 places رِزْقًا حَسَنًا after migration and after the coordinated alternatives of killing or death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated good, trial-turn-loss sequence, and later post-loss promise; I infer a deliberate contrast between transactional and durable fidelity, while the live alternative is that the two scenes merely classify different people without lexical cross-illumination.

changed_reading.before: Good provision is compensation offered by a favorable divine patron.
changed_reading.after: Good provision is expressly nontransactional: it is not the favorable condition that purchases fidelity but the share promised after fidelity no longer has a worldly condition to bargain with.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier provision is eaten and fed to the distressed poor, then spent outward, and elsewhere called noble. These recurrences give the focus allotment a relational grammar: genuinely good provision sustains a recipient and participates in generosity rather than remaining a private stock.

activation_trace.role: Provision as food anchors the earlier gift in concrete nourishment.
Feeding another moves supplied nourishment from possession into social circulation.
The allotted share is explicitly the source from which the patient worshipers act.
Money going out in expenditure supplies the outward movement of what was received.
The parallel allotted provision links the focus promise to an earlier reward formula.
Praiseworthy nobility and generosity explain one contextual quality of provision.
The focus promise retains the concrete capacity to sustain even when its setting is beyond death.

structural_cues: 22:28 commands both eating and feeding the distressed poor from what God provided.
22:35 makes spending grammatically proceed from what God provided, while 22:50 directly couples provision with كَرِيمٌ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated provision linked to nourishment, feeding, spending, and nobility; I infer that these uses lend a distributive quality to 'good provision,' while the live alternative is that the focus promise is recipient-specific and eschatological without implying onward distribution.

changed_reading.before: The migrants receive a private store of reward.
changed_reading.after: Their promised share belongs to a wider economy of divine giving whose marks are nourishment, dignity, and outward generosity, even if the focus does not specify its final material form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier conflict sequence identifies people fought, wronged, and expelled from dwellings for confessing God; defensive force preserves worship spaces, and possible earthly enablement restores public obligations. This revises migration from private heroic travel into coerced dispossession whose answer can include protection and renewed communal agency.

activation_trace.role: Mutual combat supplies the conflict field from which the focus's passive killing may emerge.
Withholding or confinement from right marks the fighters as wronged rather than aggressors.
Vindication of the wronged makes divine help answer dispossession and attack.
Passing outside a bounded place supplies the concrete expulsion behind migration.
Warding off harm makes force protective of a threatened worship ecology.
Aid and making manifest connect human support of God's cause with promised divine support.
Empowerment supplies a possible social reversal of expulsion: capacity to act again in the land.
Leaving one dwelling for another anchors the conflict sequence back in the focus migrant.

structural_cues: 22:40 says they were expelled from their dwellings without right solely for saying 'Our Lord is God' and then lists threatened monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques.
22:41 makes enablement in the land conditional and immediately fills it with prayer, almsgiving, recognized good, and restraint of wrong.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fighting, injustice, expulsion, protective resistance, support, and enablement; I infer that 22:58 gathers the same social trajectory and that provision can answer lost agency, while the live alternative confines the promise to postmortem reward rather than earthly reestablishment.

changed_reading.before: Migration is a voluntary devotional journey rewarded after an honorable death.
changed_reading.after: Migration can name forced removal under persecution, and the promise answers not only personal loss but a broken worshiping community's need for protection, vindication, and possible renewed capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah complements migration's exit from a dwelling with emphatic entry into an interior that satisfies its recipients. Spatially, the good provision is no longer only something handed over at journey's end; it can be read as hospitable admission itself.

activation_trace.role: Exit from one dwelling toward another leaves the migratory movement awaiting an inward completion.
The promised allotment is the focus element re-read through the following spatial reception.
Going into an interior supplies the destination that complements migration's departure.
Satisfaction opposed to displeasure makes the admission answer the recipient rather than merely relocate him.
The parallel mapped root's acceptance image preserves the packet's second live identity and reinforces welcomed entry.

structural_cues: 22:58 and 22:59 use consecutive emphatic لَـ promises: God will surely provide them, then will surely admit them.
The object مُّدْخَلًا repeats the entry root already carried by the verb and is qualified by the recipients' رضى.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies departure, provision, emphatic admission, and satisfaction; I infer that the second promise spatially specifies one dimension of the first, while the live alternative keeps provision and admission as two adjacent but independent rewards.

changed_reading.before: Good provision is an object delivered after the migrant's route ends.
changed_reading.after: Good provision can include the route's hospitable completion: those forced outward are brought inward to a reception they themselves find satisfying.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later life-death-life sequence places divinely caused death between two acts of giving life. Read back into 22:58, both killing and dying remain real losses, but neither is the narrative terminus at which provision becomes impossible.

activation_trace.role: Taking life supplies one real interruption named by the focus.
Loss of life supplies the other interruption coordinated with killing.
Active removal of life marks death as a divine operation inside a larger sequence rather than an autonomous final power.

structural_cues: 22:66 orders أَحْيَاكُمْ, ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ, ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ at words 3, 5, and 7, making death the middle term.
22:58's promise grammatically follows both death alternatives, and 22:59 immediately follows with satisfying entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later active life-death-life sequence; I infer that it retrospectively temporalizes the focus deaths as intervals within divine agency, while the live alternative treats 22:66 as general doctrine rather than a local specification of 22:58.

changed_reading.before: Provision compensates people after death has terminated their migration.
changed_reading.after: Death interrupts the migrants' worldly route but does not terminate the provider-recipient relation; within the surah's larger sequence it is a middle passage before renewed life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a form-distant ه ج ر branch about surpassing beauty and completion rather than the ordinary migration branches. It remains anchored in the focus root and its direct pairing with حَسَنًا and خَيْرُ, but downstream prose should present it only as intraroot resonance, never as the lexical gloss of هَاجَرُوا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: هَاجَرُوا at word 2 and the evaluative sequence رِزْقًا حَسَنًا ... خَيْرُ at words 12-17.

activation_trace.role: Surpassing the ordinary limit in beauty or completion lets migration resonate with movement beyond mere adequacy.
Explicit goodness gives the distant surpassing branch a visible focus-side attachment.
Excellence and selection complete the focus's movement from good provision to the best provider.

changed_reading.before: Migration is a loss later offset by an unrelated good reward.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root-resonance, the migration may itself bend toward surpassing completion, so the good provision fulfills the movement rather than merely reimbursing it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This ecological reading is surprising because it combines non-dominant vegetation and rain branches of migration, path, and provision; it does not claim that migrants are literally plants. It remains anchored in three focus roots and in 22:63's explicit descent-water-greening sequence. Downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for continuity through death, not an alternative dictionary translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: هَاجَرُوا, سَبِيلِ, and the threefold ر ز ق pattern at focus words 2, 4, 10, 12, and 18.

activation_trace.role: Dry abandoned vegetation supplies a material image for life cut off from its former sustaining ground.
Rain extended between cloud and earth turns the path branch into a vertical channel of replenishment.
Rain explicitly classified as provision links the promised gift to revivifying water.
Sending something down and delivering it supplies the directional action of provision.
Water delivered by pouring or irrigation supplies the material that crosses the dry interruption.
Fresh green vegetation supplies the visible outcome of replenishment after dryness.

changed_reading.before: Good provision is an item transferred after the migrants die.
changed_reading.after: As an ecological analogy, provision rehydrates a severed and apparently dried life: death resembles dormancy, and divine giving makes continuity green again.

strongest_changes: Migration changed from voluntary relocation into a trajectory that can begin in coerced expulsion and seek restored communal capacity.
Good provision changed from a delivered object into satisfying admission that completes departure with welcomed entry.
The contrast with 22:11 changed good from a precondition for fidelity into a nontransactional promise after irreversible loss.
The life-death-life sequence changed killing and dying from terminal endpoints into real but intermediate passages under continuing divine agency.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustains coexisting spatial, social, distributive, temporal, and ecological mechanisms. Its repeated provision root answers severance without erasing it, while the equal treatment of killing and ordinary death resists a narrowly heroic reading.
remaining_uncertainties: It remains uncertain whether 22:41's earthly enablement specifies the migrants' provision or only the broader social telos of their struggle.
The feeding and spending recurrences securely color the surah's provision vocabulary, but the focus does not say that its postmortem share circulates onward.
The surpassing-completion and rain-rehydration readings depend on form-distant branches and should remain resonances rather than lexical substitutions.
